StageNotes: Release channel: Long Term Servicing (LTS). This definition, PowerShell 7 (x64), follows the 7.6 line, which Microsoft Learn (PowerShell Support Lifecycle) names as the LTS release, supported until 14-Nov-2028. It never takes a release of another line. Change the line in VersionScraper.Pattern when the lifecycle page names a new LTS line.

PowerShell 7.7.0 and later Stable releases publish no MSI. The Microsoft MSI installs for all users and supports remoting and the all-users scope; the choice for servers and managed devices. The PowerShell 7 Stable (MSIX) definition is single-user and has no remoting. The PowerShell 7 (Devolutions, third party) definition is a third-party MSI.

The MSI opts the device into updates through Microsoft Update, WSUS and Configuration Manager (USE_MU=1). The detection accepts the packaged version or a newer one, so a device that was updated stays compliant.
